caption_instagram:
Buying in Istanbul from Iraq? 🇮🇶➡️🇹🇷 Your age decides the visa.

Iraqis bought 51,900+ homes in Türkiye in 2015–2025, more than any other nationality (TÜİK). In October 2026 they were 3rd, with 159 homes, after Russia (477) and Iran (193).

✅ Ordinary passport, under 15 or over 50: no visa for up to 90 days in any 180 (since 1 Sep 2024)
⚠️ Aged 15 to 50: visa needed. A one-month single-entry e-Visa if you hold a valid Schengen, US, UK or Irish visa or residence permit; otherwise apply at a Turkish consulate
✅ Iraq's Constitution (Art. 18) allows multiple citizenship, except for senior, security and sovereign posts
✅ Turkish citizenship: property worth at least $400,000, kept 3 years; spouse + children under 18 can be included; no language test
⚠️ Pay by bank, never in cash, and check the title deed before you pay
